title: Erioneuron pilosum hairy woollygrass: three Joey photographs and two real look-alikes
reason: Upgrade existing singleton Erioneuron pilosum species/genus using 3 truly distinct physically stored and personally inspected Joey Santore photos (close woolly flowering head, complete tuft, wider stand). Retain/recheck two original gross arrows, add 5 image-verified broad-feature arrows; compare actual licensed Munroa pulchella and Tridens texanus photos. Correct true ligule as hair fringe and distinguish relatively smooth glumes from hairy three-veined fertile lemmas. Preserve owner-private photo, source licenses, taxonomy holds and deferred county-range status.

relative glabrous two glumes beside one 3-nerved hairy lemma
one short lemma awn and shallow notch with 20x scale
mature spikelet floret count and one same-root specimen set
